reel:
Your dad never borrowed ₹1. He just signed as your home loan guarantor. Stop paying your EMI and the bank can call him.
Under Indian law (Contract Act, Section 128), a loan guarantor owes exactly what the borrower owes. The bank can go straight to the guarantor, and the guarantor's CIBIL score falls along with yours.
Thinking of becoming a guarantor for a family member's home loan, car loan or personal loan? Know this first.
Full story on YouTube: what really happens when you stop paying your EMI, day by day.
Has anyone in your family ever signed as a guarantor? Tell me in the comments.
#emi #loanguarantor #cibilscore
short:
EMI not paid? Here's what really happens to your home loan on day 1, day 30, day 31 and day 91, by RBI rules.
Day 1: the auto-debit bounces and you pay a bounce charge (about ₹500 + GST at a big bank). Day 30: recovery calls start, but RBI says agents can only call between 8 AM and 7 PM. Day 31: your loan is tagged SMA-1 and your CIBIL score starts to fall. Day 91: the loan becomes an NPA, and under the SARFAESI Act the bank can move on your home without a court case.
Missed EMI, loan default, credit score, recovery agent rules, home loan EMI: all of it in one countdown.
Full story on YouTube, with the twist about the paper you signed on day 1.
If your EMI bounced tomorrow, who would you call first? Tell me in the comments.
